001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
004
005/**
006 * A primitive Clafer. Primitive Clafers require built in support from the
007 * solver.
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public abstract class AstPrimClafer extends AstClafer {
012
013    AstPrimClafer(String name) {
014        super(name, null);
015    }
016
017    @Override
018    public boolean isPrimitive() {
019        return true;
020    }
021
022    @Override
023    public AstClafer extending(AstAbstractClafer superClafer) {
024        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot extend from " + getName() + " primitive");
025    }
026
027    @Override
028    public AstClafer refTo(AstClafer targetType) {
029        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot ref from " + getName() + " primitive");
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public AstClafer refToUnique(AstClafer targetType) {
034        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot ref from " + getName() + " primitive");
035    }
036
037    @Override
038    public AstConcreteClafer withGroupCard(Card groupCard) {
039        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot set group cardinality for " + getName() + " primitive");
040    }
041
042    @Override
043    public boolean hasParent() {
044        return false;
045    }
046
047    @Override
048    public AstClafer getParent() {
049        return null;
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public AstConcreteClafer addChild(String name) {
054        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot add a child under " + getName() + " primitive");
055    }
056
057    @Override
058    public AstAbstractClafer addAbstractChild(String name) {
059        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot add an abstract child under " + getName() + " primitive");
060    }
061
062    @Override
063    public AstConstraint addConstraint(AstBoolExpr constraint, SourceSpan span) {
064        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot add a constraint under " + getName() + " primitive");
065    }
066}
